where: crates/blaze-sim/src/control.rs (blaze_sim::control) vs the hand-rolled controls it replaces
what: The old seed-loop controls accepted any oracle finding; blaze_sim::control needs the words the catch says. A write-only port lane cannot run the plant to see which oracle message it trips, so it has to guess the `says` text from reading the oracle, and a wrong guess shows up only when the main agent runs the test.
